title: The Royal Rivalry, Episode 2: The Storm Arrives (full episode)
series: The Royal Rivalry (Clash of Clans fan comic), full episodes

lines: Previously, on The Royal Rivalry. Two heroes. One statue. And one very bad night.
Thanks for the gold! Same time next week?
And on a storm-dark hill, something had watched it all.
You two lost the gold together. So together, you will rebuild this wall.
Three stones at once! Carrying one stone is for people with small arms!
And every stone placed with a ruler. A wall should be straight. Obviously.
It's a wall, not a painting.
Right. A line. Down the middle. This side is mine.
It's... one wall. You do know it's one wall?
Team King snack delivery! Extra crunchy!
Tea for the Queen. Exactly as you like it.
Is that tea? Can I have some tea?
A letter! Nailed to an arrow. Signed with a muddy green thumbprint.
Dear King and Queen. Thank you for the gold. Same time next week? Love, the Goblins.
I will hunt down every goblin in this valley!
You couldn't hunt down one. I was there.
You know... your half isn't bad.
Today's weather! Clear skies all week. Not a single cloud. Lovely weather for wall building!
I'm home! Did you miss me? Is it just me, or is the wind strange today? It makes my wings tingle.
You have felt this wind before, haven't you?
Once. Many years ago, before there were walls here. Before there was a kingdom.
Ask me again tomorrow. If there is a tomorrow.
The Elixir is... fizzing. Elixir does not fizz. Why is it fizzing?
And look. Every drop is pointing the same way. At the hills.
Boys. Pack up the snacks. We're leaving.
But we just unpacked the snacks!
When goblins run away from something, everybody else should too.
Old friend. You have shielded this kingdom a hundred times. Tell me what is coming.
A storm. I have felt this wind before. I had hoped never to feel it again.
Uh, is it supposed to be night at lunchtime?
No rain. No wind. Just that humming.
It hit the line. The line is mine.
Both of you. Quiet. Look up.
Something's coming out of the clouds. Long wings. Blue scales.
An Electro Dragon! The biggest one I've ever seen!
DRAGON! Big one! Very sparkly! Everybody panic!
Wizard, don't tell them to panic!
Oh no. The lightning's jumping! Tower, to tower, to tower!
Wait. What goes up must come...
Everyone stand back. This dragon is MINE.
You can't punch something that flies.
Missed. Missed by... a lot. Uh oh. Fountain.
Still counting that as a fountain win, by the way.
Out of my way. A dragon is just a very large target. Ten arrows. Two seconds.
Every one hit! But they're bouncing off! They're melting!
Fine! Then I'll throw a barrel at it! HEAVE!
Wait. Wait! That's heading straight for... my crossbow!
You were standing where I was throwing!
Hold still. Aiming again. Dragon. Dragon. And...
Your head was in my shot.
Your shot was in my HEAD!
No, no, no! Don't bunch up! Lightning loves a crowd!
Up you get. And you. And you. Spread out! Lightning jumps between you when you stand too close!
Which way? Left? Right? I'm going in a circle!
I'll just... follow the dragon, then?
STOP! Both of you! Together, or not at all!
It's turning. Toward the Town Hall. Toward the Elixir!
Warden? Warden, what are you doing? Come back!
Nobody touches this kingdom. Not while I still stand. Rise, old friend. Shield them all!
It's breathing lightning! The biggest bolt I've ever...
The shield! The shield is holding!
NOW! Strike it together while it's tired! King, the jump! Queen, the shot!
Wait, why is there an arrow coming at...
Get up, both of you! It's breathing again!
Hold... hold... I can't... hold it...
The Warden! He's down! The Warden is down!
The dragon's leaving. It's going back into the clouds.
What is that? Burned into the sky. A mark.
Old man? Hey. Wake up. You're supposed to be yelling at us right now.
Warden. Please. Please open your eyes.
Two halves... of one hero. Remember?
Warden? No. No, no, stay with us.
Move. Let me through. He's breathing. Barely. I need the whole night, and I need quiet.
Which means the two of you need to stop shouting. For once.
I think it might be all of ours.
If you had hit the dragon instead of my helmet...
If you had stayed out of my shot...
My side. Her side. Stupid line.
Do you think he'll wake up?
He has to. Who else is going to yell at us?
The Warden's book. It's turning its own pages. It's stopped on a drawing. A storm.
And one word, written beside it. Titan.
That dragon did not come on its own. Someone sent it. Someone with the power of a storm.
To be continued. Who do you think sent the dragon? Tell me in the comments. And like and subscribe, so you don't miss the next part.
